author: Vox
description:
Sen. Elissa Slotkin says Democrats need new faces, bold ideas, and a willingness to fight. In a conversation with Astead Herndon at the University of Chicago’s Institute of Politics, the Michigan Democrat discusses what her party still gets wrong about voters, how Democrats should use their power, and why she thinks the party needs a wide-open presidential primary in 2028.

author: Vox
description:
Videos coming out of China show Alzheimer’s patients who could barely communicate answering questions, telling stories, and recognizing their family again after an experimental surgery. It’s hard to watch and not feel hopeful. But Alzheimer’s research has a long history of breakthroughs that weren’t so successful. So what’s actually happening in these videos, and should we believe it? 🧠 #Unexplainable
